Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a deep sense of altruism. Her primary motivation stems from a personal history with a deadly disease that affected her youth, fueling her tireless pursuit of a cure. Despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and professional skepticism, she demonstrates remarkable resilience. Her character development highlights her ability to maintain hope and determination against overwhelming odds.

Regarding the atmospheric elements mentioned, fluffy things in the sky rain comes from are clouds.
